title: fix(plugin-auth): a migrate-and-exit boot (OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1) never provisions the dev admin, whatever NODE_ENV says
body:
Fixes #24409

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`isDevAdminSeedArmed()` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/walled-owner-verification-path.ts`) now returns `false` when `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT` is exactly `'1'`. That is the same spelling `objectstack serve` compares before it exits. The clause sits after the `NODE_ENV === 'development'` check and before the `OS_SEED_ADMIN` off spellings, so it also wins over an explicit `OS_SEED_ADMIN=1`.

The seed (`AuthPlugin.maybeSeedDevAdmin`) and the walled owner check (`resolveWalledOwnerVerificationPathWarning`) both read this one function, so the disarm reaches both. `auth-plugin.ts` and `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` are not edited: the seed already gates on `isDevAdminSeedArmed()` and nothing else, and the fix does not need the flag read any earlier in `serve`.

## Why

`serve` checks `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT` only after the kernel bootstrap. The dev-admin seed runs on `kernel:ready`, inside that bootstrap, so a migrate-and-exit boot with `NODE_ENV=development` seeded exactly as a dev boot does. Run against an empty database, it left a known-credential login behind. Per the card's Wanted: "A migrate-and-exit boot is never a login-provisioning boot, whatever `NODE_ENV` says."

## Evidence: real `os serve` migrate-and-exit boots of an empty SQLite file

Each run went through the CLI source entry (`packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js`, which pins `NODE_ENV=development`), with `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1`, no `OS_SEED_ADMIN`, a fresh `OS_HOME` and a new database file. The fixture and database were deleted after each run. Rows were counted from the file the boot left behind.

| shape | before (`44a5011fe`) | after (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| single posture | exit 0, Migration complete, `sys_user` 1, `sys_account` 1 | exit 0, Migration complete, `sys_user` 0, `sys_account` 0 |
| single posture, `OS_SEED_ADMIN=0` (control) | exit 0, `sys_user` 0 | not re-run |
| single posture, `OS_SEED_ADMIN=1` | not run | exit 0, `sys_user` 0, `sys_account` 0 |
| `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED=true`, owner declared, membership policy declared (`invite-only`) | exit 0, Migration complete (34 plugins), 65 tables, `sys_user` 1 | exit 0, Migration complete (34 plugins), 65 tables, `sys_user` 0 |
| the same, with the seed address set to the declared owner | exit 0, 65 tables, `sys_user` 1 | exit 0, 65 tables, `sys_user` 0 |
| `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED=true`, owner undeclared | exit 1, refused in `AuthPlugin.init()`: the walled posture requires `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` | same refusal, unchanged |
| `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED=true`, owner declared, no membership policy | exit 1, FATAL: the walled posture never declared a membership policy | same refusal, unchanged |

**The walled case (the card's Done-when 3): it completes.** A walled migrate-and-exit boot of an empty database still finishes its schema sync with the seed disarmed. The walled owner check is never a refusal (it only warns), and it did not warn in either run. The two walled refusals in the table read only `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`, never the seed. They refuse the same way before and after this change, so the fix does not widen the walled case.

## Tests

New pin: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-admin-seed-migrate-and-exit.test.ts`, 9 cases. No credential is named in it. The pins count rows and never read the seeded address or password.

- `isDevAdminSeedArmed()`: armed under `NODE_ENV=development` (control). Disarmed by `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1`, also when `OS_SEED_ADMIN=1`. Any other value (`'0'`, `'true'`, `''`) stays armed, because `serve` keeps serving on those. The existing clauses are unchanged.
- The seed's `kernel:ready` step (`maybeSeedDevAdmin`) over a real `ObjectQL` and SQLite engine, on an empty store. Control: without the flag it provisions one `sys_user` and one `sys_account` (armed and seeding). With the flag, zero of each, and no banner hint.
- The walled owner check reads the same disarm, both ways. A fresh walled store whose seed address is not the owner warns on the dev boot and stays silent on the migration run. When the seed address is the owner and the store is unknowable, the dev boot stays silent and the migration run warns, because the seed no longer verifies anyone.

Run at ``da64a0936``:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/dev-admin-seed-migrate-and-exit.test.ts src/dev-admin-seed-credential-gate.test.ts src/auth-plugin-walled-owner-verification-path.test.ts src/dev-admin-seed-workspace-timezone.test.ts src/auth-plugin-walled-owner-boot-refusal.test.ts
 Test Files  5 passed (5)
      Tests  63 passed (63)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck   exit 0 (the new file is in tsconfig.test.json's program: --listFilesOnly, 1 hit)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test        exit 0 · Test Files 164 passed (164) · Tests 3158 passed | 10 skipped (3168)
```

The existing dev-seed pins (`dev-admin-seed-credential-gate`, `dev-admin-seed-workspace-timezone`, `auth-plugin-walled-owner-verification-path`) stay green. That covers Done-when 2: the `objectstack dev` seed is unchanged.

**Ablation, run once.** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the new `if (env()[MIGRATE_AND_EXIT_ENV] === '1') return false;` line (anchor 1 to 0, blob `8dcb3ca08dba` to `ebb01c7489a8`) and ran the new file. Result: 5 failed, 4 passed. The two disarm cases read `expected true to be false`, the empty-store case read `expected 1 to be +0`, and both walled cases turned. The four controls stayed green. Restore was proven: the blob matched HEAD (`8dcb3ca08dba`) and `git diff HEAD` was empty. No build was needed, because the test imports the subject from `src/` by relative path.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `da64a0936`: 67 commands, all run locally against that tree. 66 exited 0 on the first run. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: some workspace packages had no `dist/`). After `pnpm turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` it was re-run and exited 0 ("111 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load"). The other dist-reading gates (`check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`) were re-run after that build too, and all exited 0.

Reconciliation with `--ran` (each line carrying its exit code): "67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", "a DERIVED zero — all 67 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3". Families that only CI runs are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here. `test:repo` was not run locally: no `repo`-project test changed, and the derivation does not name it.

`origin/main` moved to `97cb5c5a8` while this ran. The two new commits touch only `AGENTS.md`, two ADRs and `examples/README.md`, none of which this diff touches, so the branch was not re-merged before opening.

## Acceptance notes

- `auth-plugin.ts` keeps two comments on `maybeSeedDevAdmin` that predate the new clause. One says "Both clauses (and the seeded address below) are resolved by `walled-owner-verification-path.ts`". The other says "HARD-GATED to development… Opt out within dev via OS_SEED_ADMIN=0". Both are still true, but they no longer list every clause, and the docblock of `isDevAdminSeedArmed()` now does. They were left alone because the claim allows edits to `auth-plugin.ts` only if the disarm needs them. Carrier: none.
- No docs page or skill says that a migrate boot seeds a login. `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` ("When `1`, run pending migrations and exit") is still true, and every `--seed-admin` / `OS_SEED_ADMIN` sentence in `content/docs`, `skills/` and `AGENTS.md` describes `objectstack dev`, which is unchanged. So no docs edit was made.
- Downstream: cloud picks this up at its next `.objectstack-sha` move.
